plan: In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy regardless of the number of competitors or their strategies. This is because your payment (second-highest bid) doesn't depend on your own bid unless it affects whether you win. Bidding above value risks winning at a loss; bidding below value risks losing profitable opportunities. Therefore, I will bid exactly my private value of $21 to maximize expected profit.

This is because you pay the second-highest bid, not your own bid, so there's no incentive to shade your bid up or down. Bidding exactly my value of $22 ensures I win whenever it's profitable (value > second-highest bid) and never overpay. This maximizes expected profit.
